name: robots/osrf__vrx
title: Virtual RobotX (VRX) simulation environment
intro: Virtual RobotX (VRX) simulation environment, adapted from osrf/vrx. It reads `read_sim_clock` and `read_task_info`; runs `publish_left_thrust`, `publish_right_thrust`, `publish_left_thrust_position` and `publish_right_thrust_position`. `publish_left_thrust`: publish one Float64 command on /wamv/thrusters/left/thrust; the receipt is transmission evidence only, not motion, thrust attainment or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/osrf__vrx --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/osrf__vrx --backend fake --mcp
